text:
Maya - People Ops: Hey team, follow-up thread from today's all-hands about reviews, promotions, and comp transparency. Ask short Qs here and we'll answer live.
Theo - CFO: Quick context: compensation refresh is targeted, not across-the-board. We're prioritizing where market gap >10%.
Carlos - Eng: Curious about equity refresh cadence for ICs who joined in 2023 — eligible this cycle?
Maya - People Ops: Equity refresh eligibility: generally 12 months after hire date; managers will get a list this afternoon for any exceptions.
Nina - PM: Can you clarify the appeals window and what evidence we should collect?
Maya - People Ops: Appeals window opens after calibration emails go out (expect ~2 weeks post-reviews). Evidence: impact examples, metrics, peer feedback, and links to PRs/dashboards. Keep it concise.
Sam: Are there changes to the leveling rubric this year or just clarifications?
Maya - People Ops: Mostly clarifications and examples (no new levels). Updated rubric here: https://intranet.redwood/leveling/2026-update. See the 'examples' folder for sample writeups.
Carlos - Eng: Managers: is peer feedback required for promotion packets?
Maya - People Ops: Recommended but not mandatory. Strong packets have 2-3 corroborating peer notes. Use internal template: https://intranet.redwood/hr/promotion-template
Theo - CFO: Regarding spot comp or bonuses: finance needs a business case for any >$5k one-time awards. Smaller spot recognitions can be approved by manager + People Ops.
hr-bot: Reminder: self-evals due in 48 hours. https://intranet.redwood/hr/self-eval
Nina - PM: Any updates on parental leave top-ups and flexible return-to-work options?
Maya - People Ops: Parental leave top-up still in place; we're piloting a phased return-to-work option in Q3. Details will be emailed to eligible folks next week.
Sam: Will there be an internal comp band matrix visible to managers?
Maya - People Ops: Managers get band guidance and market percentiles. IC-level exact numbers remain private; managers will receive ranges and suggested offers.
Carlos - Eng: If someone missed last cycle dev feedback but has 6 months of impact, can we submit retro packets?
Maya - People Ops: If the missed feedback is within the last 6 months, open a ticket and attach impact evidence. We'll advise on eligibility case-by-case.
Theo - CFO: We're increasing L&D stipends slightly this year — look for an email from People Ops with new limits and approval flow.
Maya - People Ops: Final reminder: submit promotion packets by EOD Monday for on-time calibration. Ping me or DM for 1:1 review. :sparkles:
